event.title: UFF-DA | Sam Licari & The Sweet Tease
event.description: UFF-DA Uff-Da — Gritty Blues-Rock with Midwestern Soul Uff-Da is a powerhouse four-piece blending gritty blues-rock energy with soulful, fuzz-drenched vibes — all rooted in unapologetic Midwestern spirit. Co-fronted by drummer/vocalist Sam McKinney and guitarist/vocalist Chris Marti, with Cody Bruggman on bass and Tim Booth on keys, Uff-Da delivers a sound that’s raw, electric, and impossible to ignore. Formed out of a shared love for sweaty live shows and authentic connection, Uff-Da has carved a loyal following across the Twin Cities music scene. Their debut self-titled album Uff-Da! is a two-year labor of love, self-produced in a DIY home studio built by the band. The result? A record that punches with raw emotion, catchy hooks, and the kind of musical chemistry you only get when every member pulls equal weight. From local venues to festival stages, Uff-Da brings a live show that’s equal parts gritty blues, powerful rock, and infectious jam sessions — keeping crowds dancing, shouting, and coming back for more. For Uff-Da, it’s not just about the music — it’s about creating momentsthat hit you in the chest and stick with you long after the last chord rings out. Sam Licari & The Sweet Tease Sam Licari and the Sweet Tease is a project by multi instrumentalist and singer/songwriter, Sam Licari. Minnesota born and bred, the versatile Sam Licari has performed with many acts around the Midwest, most notably as the bassist for Minneapolis based reggae-rock group Irie Minds , as well as Alexander Craig , Trent Romens Band, Russ Parrish & The Lone Oaks, Brother Jon Band, Red Eye Ruby, Derek Callendar and the Billytown Wranglers, Love Squad, Cupa Joe and the Sweet Cream, Matt Schatza Trio, and more. Combining his experience with a love for funk, reggae, and blues, Sam has blended them in this unique expression that is all his own, which you can hear on his debut self-titled album and his new EP Done Losin’. Get ready for a night of gritty blues-rock, soulful grooves, funk, reggae, and Midwestern swagger when Uff-Da and Sam Licari & The Sweet Tease take over the Day Block Brewing Tap Room on Thursday, October 1st from 7–10 PM. Minneapolis-based Uff-Da brings a raw, high-energy blend of blues-rock, fuzz-drenched guitar, soulful vocals, and infectious jams. With Sam McKinney on drums and vocals, Chris Marti on guitar and vocals, Cody Bruggman on bass, and Tim Booth on keys, the four-piece delivers the kind of sweaty, electric live show built for dancing, shouting along, and losing yourself in the music. Their DIY spirit and powerful chemistry make every performance feel spontaneous and alive. Opening the night, Sam Licari & The Sweet Tease bring a groove-heavy mix of funk, reggae, blues, and rock. A veteran of the Midwest music scene, Licari’s multi-instrumental background shines through in a sound that’s soulful, rhythmic, and full of personality. The Tap Room at Day Block Brewing sets the perfect backdrop for the evening, with cold craft beer on tap, great food, and a laid-back Minneapolis atmosphere where the music takes center stage. Grab a pint, order some food, settle in with friends, and let the grooves take over. Expect a night filled with big guitars, deep grooves, soulful vocals, funky rhythms, bluesy jams, dancing, and plenty of Midwestern good times. Come hungry, come thirsty, and come ready to turn it up.

event.title: Twin Citizen | Dan Bullard | Holly XO
event.description: Twin Citizen Twin Citizen is a four-piece indie rock band out of Saint Paul, Minnesota. Funk, alternative, synth, and progressive textures run underneath songs built to connect, the kind you feel in your chest in a packed room. Adam Lifto calls it “Organic Atari Music.” Joe Hartley puts it a different way: Radiohead and the Red Hot Chili Peppers covering Pink Floyd. However you describe it, every song still sounds like Twin Citizen. The band came together in 2021 chasing one idea: make music that is honest and a little adventurous, then play it like it matters. They have shared stages across the Twin Cities and earned features in Woodbury Magazine, Voyage Minnesota, and more. Right now they are heads-down on their most ambitious work yet, a self-recorded, self-produced full-length tracked in a studio they built themselves. New singles are on the way, with the record targeted for 2027. Dan Bullard Dan has been active in the Twin Cities music scene since the age of 9 and is a founding member of instrumental post rock band Trellis which debuted in 2025. The band has been building a following in the Minneapolis alternative music scene with its unique blend of post rock, post metal, desert rock, progressive rock, and psychedelic rock. Highlights so far include multiple shows at Art-A-Whirl and the opportunity to perform with underground greats such as Surrounded By Water, The Color of Cyan, PRGRPHS, North Innsbruck, and Moonlit Mushroom. The band’s debut album will release on 12/5/26 and they will perform an album release show at Day Block Brewery on that date with friends VIN, PRGRPHS, and Surrounded By Water. In 2026, Dan decided to form a solo project as an alternative outlet where he could blend elements of indie rock, emo, pop punk, pop rock, and “happy post rock.” All instruments and vocals on the project’s debut album were performed by Dan Bullard, and it will be released in 2027. The project will make its live debut at a show on 10/2/26 featuring Twin Citizen and Holly XO at Day Block Brewery with Dan Bullard on vocals and guitar, Joe Marxen (formerly of Loser Magnet) on guitar, Andrew Valentine (of Leslie) on drums, and Nick Stalls on bass. Holly XO St. Paul singer-songwriter Holly XO creates poetic, artful music that blends personal experience with themes of healing, strength, spirituality, and hope. Her work carries a thoughtful feminist perspective without preaching, inviting listeners to reflect, connect, and find meaning in their own experiences. Currently working on her debut album, Dear Holly, Holly XO is developing a distinctive artistic voice rooted in vulnerability, resilience, and emotional honesty. The album is slated for release in 2026. Indie Rock Night at Day Block Brewing Spend your Friday night with Twin Citizen, Dan Bullard, and Holly XO at Day Block Brewing on Friday, October 2nd, inside the Tap Room. Expect an intimate evening of adventurous songwriting, atmospheric sounds, and heartfelt performances, paired with fresh craft beer, good food, and the laid-back energy of a Minneapolis brewery. Twin Citizen, a four-piece from St. Paul, blends indie rock with funk, alternative, synth, and progressive textures. Their songs are built for connection—music that can move from atmospheric and adventurous to energetic and groove-driven. They describe their sound as “Organic Atari Music,” while another comparison imagines Radiohead and Red Hot Chili Peppers covering Pink Floyd. However you describe it, Twin Citizen has developed a sound distinctly their own. Dan Bullard brings his new solo project to the stage for its live debut. Drawing from indie rock, emo, pop punk, pop rock, and what he calls “happy post rock,” Dan creates music that balances emotion with an uplifting sense of movement. After years in the Twin Cities music scene and as a member of Trellis, this new project offers another side of his musical creativity. Holly XO, a St. Paul singer-songwriter, rounds out the evening with poetic and deeply personal music exploring healing, strength, spirituality, hope, and emotional honesty. Her thoughtful songwriting invites listeners into a reflective and intimate space. Grab a craft beer, order some food, settle into the Tap Room, and enjoy a night where the atmosphere is as much about connection as it is about the music. Twin Citizen • Dan Bullard • Holly XO Friday, October 2nd Day Block Brewing – Tap Room Minneapolis, MN

event.title: Danser | Midso | My Cousin Dallas
event.description: Danser Danser is a Minneapolis-based indie rock band bringing a fresh, energetic voice to the Twin Cities music scene. Emerging in 2025, the band blends melodic songwriting, driving rhythms, and an alternative edge into music that feels both accessible and adventurous. Since their debut, Danser has shared bills with a variety of emerging local acts and continued building momentum throughout Minneapolis. With catchy songs, dynamic performances, and plenty of personality, Danser is a band worth keeping an eye on Midso Midso is a Minneapolis-based power-pop and alt-country band crafting catchy, lyric-driven songs about work, love, and politics. Blending sharp storytelling with infectious hooks, the Twin Cities group brings a thoughtful, conversational edge to their songwriting while keeping things melodic and accessible. Midso’s music balances the heart of alt-country with the punch and energy of power pop. Their live recordings, including “Spine,” “Calling on You (Unplugged),” and “The Places You Will Go,” showcase their distinctive sound. My Cousin Dallas My Cousin Dallas is a Minneapolis indie rock band formed in 2000 by three friends from the University of Wisconsin–River Falls. Blending alternative, garage rock, pop, vintage rock, and a touch of nerd rock, the band describes their sound as “The Replacements and Barenaked Ladies getting together and covering Duran Duran.” Known for eclectic songwriting, memorable hooks, and entertaining live performances, My Cousin Dallas has released seven albums, including their latest The Many Moods of. Live Music at Day Block Brewing: Danser, Midso & My Cousin Dallas Get ready for an evening of eclectic, energetic, and distinctly Minneapolis music as Danser, Midso, and My Cousin Dallas take over the Tap Room at Day Block Brewing on Friday, October 9th, from 7 PM–10 PM! Headlining the evening is Danser, a Minneapolis indie rock band bringing fresh energy and personality to the Twin Cities scene. Their sound combines melodic songwriting, driving rhythms, and alternative rock influences, creating music that feels both accessible and adventurous. Expect catchy songs, dynamic performances, and an exciting introduction to a band making its mark in the local music community. Next up, Midso delivers a unique blend of power pop and alt-country. Known for lyric-driven songs about work, love, and politics, Midso balances sharp storytelling with infectious hooks and a thoughtful conversational style. Their music brings together the heart of alt-country and the punch of power pop, offering plenty of melody, energy, and songs that stay with you long after the show. Opening the night is My Cousin Dallas, a Minneapolis indie rock institution formed in 2000 by three friends from the University of Wisconsin–River Falls. With influences ranging from alternative and garage rock to pop, vintage rock, and nerd rock, the band has developed an eclectic sound all their own. Imagine The Replacements and Barenaked Ladies covering Duran Duran—and you’re getting close. With seven albums and a reputation for memorable hooks and entertaining live shows, My Cousin Dallas is sure to bring a lively finish to the night. All of this takes place inside the welcoming Tap Room at Day Block Brewing, where great live music meets freshly brewed local beer and delicious food. Grab a pint, order something from the kitchen, and settle in for a night of guitars, grooves, singalong melodies, and Twin Cities musical character. Join us Friday, October 9th, from 7 PM–10 PM at Day Block Brewing for a full night of local music, cold beer, good food, and an atmosphere built for discovering your next favorite band.

event.title: Social Pariah | Taste of Vervain | Sensing Agony | A Martyrs Dilemma
event.description: Social Pariah Minnesota-based Social Pariah is a three-piece metal and grunge band bringing a heavy, raw edge to the local music scene. Drawing inspiration from ’90s grunge and hard-hitting metal, their sound combines gritty guitar work, powerful vocals, and crushing rhythms. Influences including Alice in Chains, Pantera, Acid Bath, Crowbar, Soundgarden, and Mudvayne shape their aggressive yet melodic approach. With original music and a growing presence in the Minnesota scene, Social Pariah is pushing their sound in a heavier direction. Taste of Vervain Minneapolis-based Taste of Vervain delivers a crushing, progressive take on deathcore, combining heavy distortion, intricate rhythms, dissonant textures, and dynamic songwriting. The Twin Cities quartet—Justin, Kieran, Garrett, and Cade—pushes beyond straightforward brutality with a sound that balances aggression and atmosphere. Self-producing their music, the band released their six-song EP Until I Cease in 2025, showcasing their technical musicianship, intense vocals, and boundary-pushing approach to modern extreme metal. Sensing Agony Minnesota-based Sensing Agony is a post-hardcore band bringing raw intensity, melodic aggression, and emotionally charged energy to the Twin Cities scene. Founded by guitarist Kyan and drummer Ben before expanding with Shawn on bass and Jessica on vocals, the band draws from melodic hardcore and heavy alternative influences. Their powerful performances combine crushing instrumentation with dynamic vocals, showcased on singles including “House of Cards” and “Happy Song.” Sensing Agony is quickly establishing themselves as a band to watch. A Martyrs Dilemma Minnesota-based A Martyrs Dilemma delivers a crushing blend of modern metal and extreme heaviness, combining aggressive instrumentation, intense vocals, and dynamic songwriting. The band has built a presence in the Twin Cities metal scene through powerful live performances and uncompromising music. Their 2024 album REINVENTING HATRED showcases their relentless approach across seven tracks, including “Heavy Lies The Crown,” “Unhinged,” “Beyond God,” and “Villainized.” A Martyrs Dilemma continues pushing their sound into darker, heavier territory. Live at Day Block Brewing: Social Pariah, Taste of Vervain, Sensing Agony & A Martyrs Dilemma Get ready for a crushing night of Minnesota metal, grunge, deathcore, and post-hardcore at Day Block Brewing on Saturday, October 10. Doors open at 5:00 PM, with music from 6:00 PM–10:00 PM inside the Tap Room. Social Pariah brings a raw combination of metal and ’90s grunge, blending gritty guitar work, powerful vocals, and crushing rhythms. Drawing inspiration from Alice in Chains, Pantera, Acid Bath, Crowbar, Soundgarden, and Mudvayne, their sound delivers both aggression and melody. Taste of Vervain unleashes a technical and progressive take on deathcore, combining brutal heaviness with intricate rhythms, dissonant textures, and atmospheric songwriting. Their 2025 EP Until I Cease showcases the band’s relentless and boundary-pushing approach to modern extreme metal. Sensing Agony delivers emotionally charged post-hardcore fueled by melodic aggression, crushing instrumentation, and dynamic vocals. With an increasingly powerful presence in the Twin Cities scene, their intense live performances promise to leave an impression. Rounding out the night is A Martyrs Dilemma, bringing uncompromising deathcore and modern metal intensity to the stage. Their 2024 album REINVENTING HATRED showcases the band’s darker, heavier approach and relentless energy. Four Minnesota bands. One heavy night. Come ready for crushing riffs, intense vocals, and nonstop energy at Day Block Brewing. Saturday, October 10 | Doors 5 PM | Music 6–10 PM | 21+ Presale: $10 | Door: $15

event.title: Front Porch | Triple Fiddle
event.description: Front Porch Described as “old time acid jazz punk rock barn burning bluegrass fusion that will have you jumping,” Front Porch independently released their first album “Shallow Grave” in the fall of 2023. Gaining attention across the U.S. with their energetic live shows, their performances highlight their skillful instrumentation, where foot stomping clawhammer banjo, ripping mandolin, guitar and fiddle melodies are at the forefront of their driving sound. Front Porch has been nominated for bluegrass band of the year for the Arkansas Country Music Awards in 2024, 2025, and 2026, has headlined many festivals, and has supported artists such as Bela Fleck, Sierra Hull, Infamous Stringdusters, and Del McCoury. They are currently on tour supporting their sophomore album “Toolbox.” Their most recent album highlights their continued growth as musicians and songwriters, where the band pushes the boundaries of American roots and bluegrass while creating their own unique sound. All four band members write songs for this album which creates a diversity of styles that reads as a cohesive collection. Guitarist John Henry pairs thoughtful storytelling with ripping guitar runs on his song, “Great Grandaddy’s Barn.” Bassist Cameron Keeling brings a traditional bluegrass feel with high lonesome harmonies on “Truer Words.” Mandolinist Alex Hawf brings dark jazz inspired melodies to his tune, “Skvader.” And banjo and fiddle player Petey Wesley brings an old time vibe with his song “Meet me in the Ground.” Triple Fiddle Triple Fiddle is a Minneapolis-based fiddle ensemble featuring three powerhouse Minnesota fiddlers alongside guitarist Hannah Hendrickson. Known for soaring three-part fiddle harmonies and lush vocal arrangements, the group brings together an adventurous mix of honkytonk, western swing, bluegrass, jazz, classical chamber music, and Scandinavian folk. Their repertoire spans original songs, covers, and traditional fiddle tunes, creating a sound that is both deeply rooted and refreshingly modern. With years of experience performing throughout the Midwest, Triple Fiddle delivers a dynamic and captivating live experience that showcases the incredible possibilities of string-driven music. Front Porch & Triple Fiddle at Day Block Brewing Get ready for a night of high-energy American roots music, bluegrass, old-time, western swing, and genre-bending fiddle-driven sounds as Front Porch and special guests Triple Fiddle take over the Tap Room at Day Block Brewing on Friday, October 16th. Described as “old time acid jazz punk rock barn burning bluegrass fusion that will have you jumping,” Front Porch brings a wild and energetic approach to bluegrass. Foot-stomping clawhammer banjo, ripping mandolin, guitar, fiddle, and soaring harmonies drive a sound that stretches well beyond traditional roots music. Currently touring behind their sophomore album Toolbox, Front Porch blends storytelling, instrumental fireworks, high-lonesome harmonies, dark jazz influences, and old-time melodies into a performance built to get the room moving. Joining them is Triple Fiddle, a powerhouse Minnesota ensemble featuring three fiddlers and guitarist Hannah Hendrickson. Their music showcases soaring three-part fiddle harmonies, layered vocals, and intricate arrangements drawing from bluegrass, honkytonk, western swing, jazz, classical chamber music, and Scandinavian folk. The result is beautiful, energetic, and completely captivating. The atmosphere at Day Block Brewing’s Tap Room will be relaxed, welcoming, and lively—a perfect setting for letting the music take over. Grab a cold craft beer, enjoy some food from the brewery, gather around with friends, and settle in for a night where traditional American music meets adventurous modern musicianship. Whether you’re a longtime bluegrass fan or simply looking for something different, this is a night to tap your toes, stomp your feet, raise a pint, and enjoy some incredible live music. Front Porch • Triple Fiddle 🎻 Friday, October 16th 🍺 Day Block Brewing – Tap Room 📍 Minneapolis, MN Come for the beer. Stay for the music. Leave with your feet tired from dancing.

event.title: 13 Arrows ( EP Release Show ) | Cain & Co. | The Hazy Phase
event.description: 13 Arrows ( EP Release Show ) Bringing rock and roll back to its raw, unbound, and authentic roots since 2016. Cain & Co. Hailing from St. Paul, MN, Michael Cain leads a dynamic blues-rock ensemble steeped in Southern tradition. Drawing inspiration from legends like The Allman Brothers, The Black Crowes and Blackberry Smoke, the band crafts a sound that’s both soulful and electrifying. The Hazy Phase The Hazy Phase is a gritty blues rock trio hailing from the Minneapolis area, known for fusing blues raw slide guitar work with heavy rhythms and vintage soul. Formed in 2020, the band brings together the talents of Dave McDevitt on vocals and guitar, Chris Milinovich on cigar-box guitars, and David Quamme on drums. Their sound is rooted in the deep tradition of blues legends like Muddy Waters and Freddie King, filtered through the swagger of ZZ Top and the modern edge of bands like Left Lane Cruiser, The Black Keys, and Jack White. Rock & Blues Night 13 Arrows EP Release Show at Day Block Brewing Celebrate a night of rock, blues, great food, and fresh beer as 13 Arrows headlines a special EP Release Show for their new release, Gasoline on Fire, at Day Block Brewing on Saturday, October 17th, from 7–10 PM inside the Tap Room. Since 2016, 13 Arrows has been bringing rock and roll back to its raw, unbound, and authentic roots. With Gasoline on Fire, the band continues to channel that unapologetic spirit into a sound built for loud guitars, driving rhythms, and pure rock and roll energy. event.description: Demon Alcohol ( A Tribute to Ozzy Osbourne ) Demon Alcohol is a Minnesota-based tribute to Ozzy Osbourne, bringing the legendary Prince of Darkness’ music to life with a hard-hitting live show. Covering Ozzy’s iconic solo career and classic heavy metal catalog, the band delivers crushing guitar riffs, powerful vocals, thunderous rhythms, and the unmistakable spirit of Ozzy’s music. From timeless hits to deeper cuts, Demon Alcohol celebrates the sound, energy, and theatrical attitude that have made Ozzy a defining figure in heavy metal for generations. KISSin Time KISSin Time is a Minnesota-based tribute band celebrating the music, spectacle, and larger-than-life rock ’n’ roll of KISS. Bringing the band’s iconic catalog to the stage, KISSin Time delivers powerful guitars, driving rhythms, soaring vocals, and the unmistakable attitude of classic KISS. With a high-energy performance built for rock fans, the band captures the excitement and theatrical spirit of a KISS concert while keeping the focus on the songs that made the legendary group a cornerstone of rock history. Demon Alcohol – A Tribute to Ozzy Osbourne and KISSin Time bring the music, attitude, and larger-than-life energy of two iconic acts to the intimate Day Block Brewing Tap Room. Demon Alcohol delivers the dark, powerful side of Ozzy’s legendary catalog, featuring crushing guitar riffs, thunderous drums, powerful vocals, and classic heavy-metal anthems from Ozzy’s solo career. Expect plenty of headbanging, air guitar, and that unmistakable Ozzy attitude. KISSin Time brings the spectacle and rock ’n’ roll swagger of KISS to the stage with powerful guitars, driving rhythms, soaring vocals, and the theatrical energy associated with one of rock’s most recognizable bands. Expect big songs, big personalities, and a live show designed to get the room moving. The Day Block Tap Room will be turned into a rock ’n’ roll hangout for the evening. Grab a locally brewed Day Block beer or your favorite drink, enjoy some food from the kitchen, and settle in with friends for a night packed with classic rock, heavy metal, and plenty of volume. Whether you’re a longtime Ozzy fan, a devoted KISS Army member, or simply looking for a loud and fun way to spend Thanksgiving weekend, expect guitars, drums, big vocals, classic songs, theatrical performances, and an unforgettable night of rock. Two legends. Two tribute bands. One epic night at Day Block Brewing.

event.title: The Tolerables | Of The Orchard | Sensing Agony | Salt Fangs
event.description: The Tolerables The Tolerables are a Minneapolis-based family pop-punk band formed in 2009, bringing high-energy hooks, driving guitars, and plenty of personality to the Twin Cities music scene. Inspired by bands like Paramore, Green Day, and MxPx, their music combines catchy songwriting with an energetic, playful live presence. Featuring brothers Luke, Tyler, and Jordan alongside Christie and Travis, The Tolerables are known for keeping audiences moving, singing along, and having a great time Of The Orchard Of The Orchard is a Minneapolis-based pop-rock band blending nostalgic ’90s and early-2000s rock with upbeat, hook-driven songwriting. Their sound combines catchy melodies, thoughtful lyrics, and influences from pop, alternative rock, folk, and pop-punk. With a knack for turning stories about growing up, relationships, and finding your place into infectious songs, Of The Orchard brings a fun, energetic Midwestern spirit to the stage. Their latest music showcases their signature “Sota Pop Rock” sound. Sensing Agony Sensing Agony is a Minnesota-based post-hardcore band delivering a powerful mix of melodic aggression, crushing instrumentation, and emotionally charged vocals. Founded by guitarist Kyan and drummer Ben before expanding with Shawn on bass and Jessica on vocals, the band draws from melodic hardcore and heavy alternative influences. Their music balances intense screams, dynamic melodies, heavy riffs, and breakdown-driven energy. With singles including “House of Cards” and “Happy Song,” Sensing Agony brings raw emotion and intensity to every performance. Salt Fangs Salt Fangs is a Minneapolis-based independent band bringing a fresh, energetic presence to the Twin Cities music scene. With a growing live profile and appearances alongside fellow local and regional artists, Salt Fangs delivers an engaging sound built for the stage. Their performances bring intensity, personality, and a contemporary edge to Minneapolis’ vibrant independent music community. The band continues to build momentum through live shows and new music, establishing their own place in the local scene. The Tolerables • Of The Orchard • Sensing Agony • Salt Fangs Friday, December 4th | 7–10 PM | Day Block Brewing – Tap Room Get ready for a full night of Minnesota music as Salt Fangs, Sensing Agony, Of The Orchard, and The Tolerables bring four distinct sounds to the Day Block Brewing Tap Room. Salt Fangs opens the night, bringing a contemporary Minneapolis sound with plenty of energy, personality, and intensity. Their engaging live presence sets the tone for an evening built around discovering and celebrating local music. Sensing Agony turns up the intensity with their emotionally charged post-hardcore sound. Expect crushing guitar riffs, powerful vocals, dynamic melodies, and breakdown-driven energy that brings a heavier edge to the night. Of The Orchard follows with their upbeat “Sota Pop Rock,” blending nostalgic ’90s and early-2000s rock with pop, alternative, folk, and pop-punk influences. Catchy melodies and thoughtful lyrics make their set both energetic and approachable. Headlining the night, The Tolerables bring their high-energy Minneapolis pop-punk sound to the Tap Room. Drawing inspiration from bands like Paramore, Green Day, and MxPx, they deliver driving guitars, huge hooks, sing-along moments, and a playful live presence designed to keep the room moving. Enjoy the intimate Day Block Tap Room atmosphere while grabbing a locally brewed beer, your favorite drink, and some food from the kitchen. It’s the perfect Friday night setting to hang with friends, support Minnesota bands, and experience four different sides of the local music scene. Four Minnesota bands. One great night at Day Block Brewing.

Our in-house kombucha is available in Watermelon Strawberry, Margarita, Blackberry, and Chai Tea, or try a $10 flight to sample them all. $5 pints are available for on-site enjoyment, and $5 microgreen blends are available to take home. It is a simple way to extend your market morning, grab some lunch and enjoy a drink with friends, and bring home fresh greens for the week. $5 pints $5 microgreen blends to-go $10 kombucha flights
